newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Two top Argentine economy ministry officials quit.
newsitem.headline: Two top Argentine economy ministry officials quit.

text.p: Two top aides to Argentina's new Economy Minister Roque Fernandez resigned on Friday, officials said.
The ministry confirmed that Jose Maria Farre, deputy secretary of public finances, had quit. It was not immediately clear why he had resigned and he could not be reached for comment.

Guillermo Calvo, an aide to Fernandez on macroeconomic policy, told Reuters he had also left. Calvo said he had only planned to be part of Fernandez's team in its early stages and then return to academic life.

Economist Calvo is a professor at the University of Maryland. He was sharply criticized about two weeks ago for saying politicians were "playing cards on the deck of the Titanic", accusing them of dithering on economic policy.
Fernandez replaced former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo in late July after President Carlos Menem asked Cavallo for his resignation.
